_about: Pro's prices come from the CSV files in i18n/prices/: lifetime-prices.csv (Country, Country code, Currency, Price), or App Store Connect exports (In-App Purchases > Privaro Pro > Price Schedule; download the current prices as CSV). To update, replace those files and run build.py; a country listed twice must have the same price in both. i18n/countries.json maps App Store Connect's country names to ISO codes. The site guesses the visitor's country in their browser (time zone, then language settings); a country with no price falls back to the country of the page's language (lang_country), then to base. storefront: places with no App Store of their own, and the country whose store their people buy from (Puerto Rico and Guam the United States', Réunion and Martinique France's, and so on); they are shown that country's price.
